failures: CONTAMINATED_FEATURE: probable_starter_era_gap coefficient (-0.2868) was fit on live/current ESPN probables ERA applied retroactively to historical training dates (confirmed by this artifact's own experimental_note: ESPN returns the SAME current ERA for a pitcher regardless of query date, verified 3 months apart). The coefficient sign is backwards -- a worse home starter ERA should lower home win probability, not raise it -- and the feature itself predicted outcomes at 25% accuracy (3/12) in the window checked, worse than chance. The 71.1% holdout hit rate (96/135) that otherwise clears the primary bar is not evidence this model is skillful: it went 9-3 during a 3-day span by picking 11 of 12 home teams, matching the market favorite (also 9-3) with no independent edge from the contaminated feature. meets_primary_holdout_metrics is force-set False here despite the raw numbers clearing the bar, because the bar itself is not a valid signal for a model whose defining feature cannot be honestly backtested. Do not flip this back to True by re-running holdout evaluation alone -- the fix is retraining without probable_starter_era_gap (or refitting it only once the point-in-time archive at data/point_in_time/mlb_probable_starters.jsonl has enough real history to support a real coefficient), not accumulating more calls on the same coefficient.
